variant: Full-precision dense prefill followed by one-shot physical per-KV-head pruning; generated tokens are retained without pruning.
quality_reporting: Report all individual regressions and paired bootstrap intervals; passing point-estimate gates is not a proof of non-inferiority. The 4-bit baseline is a descriptive comparison, not a threshold-tuning target.
early_stop: Stop for futility if a completed dataset breaches its pre-specified gate. Retain every completed output and state the incomplete sample count.
selection: Seed 20261103; exclude all previously selected IDs and their document contexts. 16 per dataset; Qasper/LCC include 6 examples at 2K-4K, 6 at 4K-8K, 4 at 8K-16K; HotpotQA includes 16 at 8K-16K.
known_development_regressions: qasper-130: omitted method details; -18.17 pp word F1; remains a real pruning failure
rejected_candidate: 8-bit prefill version at d1735fa failed the complete 16-case Qasper subset (-6.79 pp) and was stopped after 21 paired cases. Do not relabel those cases held-out for the revised candidate.
performance_reporting: Also compare full KV and fused 4-bit KV, keep TTFT/whole-request/decode metrics separate, distinguish MLX allocation from physical memory. No larger-model claim.
